decisions.feature: Level-based replacements for four trade evolutions
decisions.stock_behavior: Kadabra, Machoke, Graveler and Haunter require trade evolution.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Each evolves at level 37.

decisions.stock_behavior: Held-item evolutions require trading while holding the item.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: King's Rock, Metal Coat, Dragon Scale, Up-Grade, DeepSeaTooth and DeepSeaScale evolutions use EVO_ITEM and consume the item.

decisions.stock_behavior: Ultra Ball costs 1200.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Ultra Ball costs 100.

decisions.stock_behavior: Max Revive costs 4000.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Max Revive costs 200.

decisions.feature: Normal Mart Ultra Ball and Max Revive availability
decisions.stock_behavior: Normal Mart stock varies by progression and does not universally expose these items.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The eleven normal Mart scripts expose Ultra Ball and Max Revive from their Vanilla+ stock lists.

decisions.feature: Normal Mart evolution stones and PP Max availability
decisions.stock_behavior: The six standard evolution stones and PP Max are not universally stocked in normal Marts.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Normal Mart stock includes Sun, Moon, Fire, Thunder, Water and Leaf Stones plus PP Max; Rare Candy is not added.

decisions.stock_behavior: A successful stone evolution consumes the stone.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Sun, Moon, Fire, Thunder, Water and Leaf Stones remain after a successful evolution.

decisions.stock_behavior: Teaching with a TM consumes it.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: TM01-TM50 remain after successful teaching.

decisions.stock_behavior: Overworld tutors are gated by one-time taught flags.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The one-time taught flag gates are removed so the tutors can be used repeatedly.

decisions.feature: HM move replacement through normal learn flow
decisions.stock_behavior: HM moves are rejected by normal move replacement.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: HM moves may be replaced through the normal move-replacement flow.

decisions.stock_behavior: Running requires FLAG_SYS_B_DASH in addition to normal movement restrictions.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: FLAG_SYS_B_DASH is no longer required; underwater and disallowed-metatile restrictions remain.

decisions.stock_behavior: Repel expiration only reports that the effect wore off.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: If another Repel is available the player is offered immediate reuse and the Repel type can cycle.

decisions.feature: Easier fishing response and repeat policy
decisions.stock_behavior: Rod-dependent short response windows and optional repeated dot rounds apply.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: All rods use a 90-frame response window and optional repeat chances are zero, while the rod-dependent required-round RNG remains: Old 1, Good 1-3, Super 1-6.

decisions.stock_behavior: Low HP starts SE_LOW_HEALTH.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The low-HP warning sound is not started.

decisions.stock_behavior: Field poison can reduce HP to zero.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Field poison decrements only above 1 HP.

decisions.stock_behavior: Flash sets the stock partial illumination level.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Flash sets full visibility with flash level 0.

decisions.stock_behavior: Bike type is changed through the normal inventory/use flow.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: R toggles Mach and Acro while stationary, except on Cycling Road and while incompatible bike movement state is active.

decisions.feature: HM field access from item plus badge
decisions.stock_behavior: Field access is tied to a party Pokemon knowing the HM plus badge/story restrictions.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The corresponding HM item and badge are required; neither alone is sufficient.

decisions.feature: HM items as field tools without learned move
decisions.stock_behavior: Party learned-move checks and party cursor actor selection authorize HM field actions.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: HM01-HM08 dispatch existing field actions from item plus badge without teaching or requiring the move; map, direction, story and puzzle restrictions remain.

decisions.stock_behavior: Bag provides vanilla ordering/manual movement only.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Normal sortable pockets support Name, Type, Quantity and Value sorting with deterministic tie breaks and Turkish-aware name collation; TM/HM and Berry canonical order is preserved.

decisions.feature: Persistent Bag auto-sort and sort mode
decisions.stock_behavior: No per-pocket persistent sort mode or auto-sort setting exists.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Sort mode and auto-sort mask persist in the VP5 reserved SaveBlock1 metadata; TM/HM and Berries cannot auto-sort.

decisions.stock_behavior: Stored PC items retain vanilla ordering/manual movement.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: PC items compact and sort with the shared Name, Type, Quantity or Value comparator using plaintext quantities.

decisions.stock_behavior: The party item flow lacks the Vanilla+ direct move/swap action.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Ordinary held items can move to an empty destination or swap between party Pokemon; Mail stays on its separate path.

decisions.stock_behavior: Only one registered item is persisted.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Up to four quick items persist in VP5 reserved metadata; slot 0 stays synchronized with the vanilla registeredItem field and missing Bag items are pruned.

decisions.stock_behavior: The normal summary does not expose the Vanilla+ IV/EV/Hidden Power panel.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Core data supports six IVs, six EVs, total EV and Gen III Hidden Power type; presentation toggling belongs to UI.

decisions.stock_behavior: Move Relearner access follows the scripted house flow.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Party access rejects Eggs, missing Heart Scale and no relearnable moves; one Heart Scale is consumed only after a move is actually learned.

decisions.stock_behavior: Renaming is reached through the Name Rater flow.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Party shortcut preserves player OT ID plus OT name ownership checks and rejects Eggs; naming-screen presentation remains UI-owned.

decisions.stock_behavior: Fast text advances with stock printer pacing.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Fast mode may render up to four printable glyphs per frame while respecting text-state barriers.

decisions.stock_behavior: Global repeat timing is 40/5 frames.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Global repeat timing is 24/3 frames.

decisions.stock_behavior: Common field-move banner and Pokemon sprite use stock presentation timing.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Banner, sprite movement, hold and tile reveal timings are accelerated.

decisions.stock_behavior: Pokemon Center sequence uses stock placement, flash and nurse timing.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Pokemon Center-only presentation delays are shortened while fanfare completion remains intact.

decisions.stock_behavior: No normal Start Menu RTC settings row exists.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: RTC settings are exposed only through in-game Options, separate from title Options.

decisions.stock_behavior: Player-facing safe correction policy is absent.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Invalid RTC states block correction and correction adjusts local displayed game time rather than hardware RTC.

decisions.stock_behavior: The Vanilla+ player correction helper is absent.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: localTimeOffset, lastBerryTreeUpdate and day state are safely realigned without simulating missed rewards.

decisions.stock_behavior: Stock weighted encounter slots expose the original regional species set.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: All 386 National Dex species participate in habitat-appropriate route-local pools.

decisions.stock_behavior: Encounter slots use stock weighting and can immediately repeat.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Each local-pool species occurs once per Fisher-Yates bag with immediate boundary-repeat prevention.

decisions.feature: Dynamic wild levels from party average
decisions.stock_behavior: Wild levels come from stock encounter slot ranges.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Living non-Egg party average anchors a uniform +/-15 range clamped to levels 2-100.

decisions.stock_behavior: Special systems use their stock generators.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Normal encounters use Phase 9 while Pike, Pyramid, roamers and outbreaks retain explicit special handling.

decisions.stock_behavior: Route 119 six-tile Feebas override applies.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The old tile override is not used by fishing; Feebas participates through habitat pools.

decisions.stock_behavior: Ultra Ball multiplier is 20, i.e. 2x in the Gen III formula.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Ultra Ball multiplier is 40, i.e. 4x.

decisions.stock_behavior: No explicit derived quest tracker exists.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: One current main-story objective is derived from existing Emerald flags and vars without second persisted quest state.

decisions.stock_behavior: No GOREV action exists.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Start menu exposes the active objective UI.

decisions.stock_behavior: Region Map has no active-objective target focus.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The active objective exposes canonical region target/marker information.

decisions.stock_behavior: No derived local quest target is exposed.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: The active objective resolves local object-event or coordinate target semantics; rendering remains presentation-owned.

decisions.feature: Current-box Species, Level and Type sorting
decisions.stock_behavior: Pokemon Storage lacks these Vanilla+ sort operations.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Current box sorts by National Dex, level descending or primary/secondary type with Dex tie breaks; Eggs follow normal Pokemon and empties are last.

decisions.stock_behavior: No one-action stable compaction exists.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: Occupied current-box slots compact toward the front without otherwise reordering Pokemon.

decisions.feature: PC held-item GIVE and TAKE to Bag
decisions.stock_behavior: Normal PC Pokemon context lacks the Vanilla+ low-friction Bag give/take flow.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: A non-Egg Pokemon can receive an item from the Bag or return a non-Mail held item directly to the Bag with atomic capacity safeguards.

decisions.feature: START Box-to-Party and Party-to-Box quick transfer
decisions.stock_behavior: Transfers require the normal storage menu flow.
decisions.vanillaplus_behavior: START performs context quick transfer while preserving party-full, box-full, last-usable-party and Mail safeguards.
